analysis: The PR is documentation-only: docs/reference/configuration.md adds a scheduler-prefill benchmark CLI flag (--prefill-fixed-prompt) and a note that scheduler prefill applies the MLXMemoryGuard settings before model loading; docs/reference/model-registry-format.md adds a 'Flint local package exception' table (lines 395-404 head) covering exact 'flint' architecture identity, shard-only local discovery with a bounded config of at most 1,048,576 bytes, strict weight inventory, native KV precision and the separation of catalog publication from local discovery. No executable code, keys, endpoints or auth paths change. The visible head text of configuration.md (lines 322-611) is context and did not appear to change its security posture. It states that the SSD prefix cache tier keeps its encryption and TTL (T-041 unchanged), that benchmark and model-specific env vars are not forwarded to LaunchAgents, and that the hash-verification controls do not skip load checks. The Flint doc says local discovery does not publish or activate a catalog and that the strict checkpoint inventory applies, which matches T-012/T-027 expectations, though the doc cannot show the code enforces this. I could not review the underlying code behind the Flint claims (ModelScanner.isMLXModel, boundedModelConfiguration, FlintCheckpoint). Whether local shard-only discovery with no synthetic index keeps weight-hash verification and advertised-model allowlist gating (A-004, T-012, T-027) is unverified here, and the doc's claims should be checked against the corresponding code PRs. No concrete security regression is identified from these changes.
